metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Centralized logging across accounts on AWS subtitle: Workload accounts send CloudWatch Logs through a subscription and CloudTrail through the organization trail to one Log Archive account direction: down legend: solid: Log delivery dotted: Encryption and queries groups: cloud: { type: aws:cloud } workloads: { type: aws:generic-dashed, icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Workloads OU, in: cloud } account-a: { type: aws:account, label: Workload account A, in: workloads } account-b: { type: aws:account, label: Workload account B, in: workloads } archive: { type: aws:account, label: Log Archive account, in: cloud } nodes: flow-a: { icon: aws:vpc-flow-logs, label: Amazon VPC Flow Logs, note: Network traffic, in: account-a } logs-a: { icon: aws:cloudwatch-logs, label: Amazon CloudWatch Logs, note: Subscription filter, in: account-a } trail-a: { icon: aws:cloudtrail, label: AWS CloudTrail, note: Organization trail, in: account-a } flow-b: { icon: aws:vpc-flow-logs, label: Amazon VPC Flow Logs, note: Network traffic, in: account-b } logs-b: { icon: aws:cloudwatch-logs, label: Amazon CloudWatch Logs, note: Subscription filter, in: account-b } trail-b: { icon: aws:cloudtrail, label: AWS CloudTrail, note: Organization trail, in: account-b } firehose: { icon: aws:data-firehose, label: Amazon Data Firehose, note: Delivery stream, in: archive } search: { icon: aws:opensearch-service, label: Amazon OpenSearch Service, note: Search and dashboards, in: archive } bucket: { icon: aws:simple-storage-service-bucket, label: Central log bucket, note: "Object Lock, lifecycle rules", in: archive } athena: { icon: aws:athena, label: Amazon Athena, note: SQL over the logs, in: archive } kms: { icon: aws:key-management-service, label: AWS Key Management Service, note: Log encryption key, in: archive } edges: - flow-a -> logs-a: publish - flow-b -> logs-b: publish - logs-a, logs-b -> firehose: subscription - trail-a, trail-b -> bucket: deliver - firehose -> search: index - firehose -> bucket: back up - athena ..> bucket: query # The bucket asks KMS for data keys; written key first so KMS sits on the Firehose row. - { from: kms, to: bucket, arrow: start, line: dotted, label: SSE-KMS }

svg.title: Centralized logging across accounts on AWS
svg.desc: Centralized logging across accounts on AWS. 11 components in 5 groups. Connections: Amazon VPC Flow Logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs (publish); Amazon VPC Flow Logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs (publish); Amazon CloudWatch Logs to Amazon Data Firehose (subscription); Amazon CloudWatch Logs to Amazon Data Firehose (subscription); AWS CloudTrail to Central log bucket (deliver); AWS CloudTrail to Central log bucket (deliver); Amazon Data Firehose to Amazon OpenSearch Service (index); Amazon Data Firehose to Central log bucket (back up); Amazon Athena to Central log bucket (query); AWS Key Management Service to Central log bucket (SSE-KMS).

text.tspan: CENTRALIZED LOGGING ACROSS ACCOUNTS ON AWS
Workload accounts send CloudWatch Logs through a subscription and CloudTrail through the organization trail to one
